subject: Community clean-up plan update
text: The map for Saturday is ready, and the parking lot should be open by eight, so we can unload early. We will meet at the east gate, not the side path like last month, because the contractor is doing repaving near there. I put a small board by the coffee cart so people can still find it easily. If the morning gets cold, the community room upstairs is available from nine, which gives us a warm place to sort gloves and talk through the zones. That feels more practical than standing outside while we explain the cleanup plan. Please reply with your zone choice by tonight, since we need to print the sign-in sheet. If the forecast turns rainy, we could move the same session to next Sunday morning instead, with no extra effort. The indoor alternative would work too, but I think fresh air helps. Bring water, a hat if the sun is strong, and a reusable bag if you have one. We will keep the usual snacks for afterwards. I appreciate everyone making this feel so welcoming, even with all the tiny changes. We also have a quiet role for someone who prefers watching the trail. I will bring the first aid kit and pickers. The event is short, but small things matter. Please tell me if you need a parking pass nearby.
